items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: starring Cybil Shepherd. So I did this movie for CBS

ctx.x: Great. You’ve done some fairly well known films, and do you like writing for film?

Yeah. I haven’t done it for a long time. I mean I left it for about 14 years until about a year and a half ago when this director called me, Karen Arthur called me and said I’ve got this project that you should really think about it. So it was called “Journey of the Heart,” it was about an autistic savant from Waltham, Massachusetts, unbelievably. That’s where he lives, where I went to junior high school, and starring Cybil Shepherd. So I did this movie for CBS and I really enjoy it. I enjoy it a lot. So I’m…
I was just going to — yeah, you made me think of — does your curiosity extend into the available technology these days to supposedly make your life more creative?
